claude_proposed_widenings.name: multi_grant_class_feature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Faithful Steed grants two distinct effects at level-up time: a passive always-prepared grant and an active free-cast use-count resource. The current ClassFeatureMechanics only has a single `activation` family with one `effect` field. No existing family supports encoding two co-equal effects from a single class feature acquisition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You always have the Find Steed spell prepared. You can also cast the spell once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access (as ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The 'always prepared' mechanic adds a named spell to the paladin's always-prepared list. The v4 taxonomy has `grant_spell_access` as an effect atom but ClassFeatureEffect only has GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. A new variant is needed to encode passive permanent spell preparation grants from class features.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You always have the Find Steed spell prepared.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_free_spell_cast (as ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The free-cast mechanic allows casting a specific named spell once per long rest without expending a spell slot. This is mechanically distinct from grant_extra_action (which grants a generic action) and from heal_hp. A new ClassFeatureEffect variant is needed that carries: spellId, use_count resource, and resetCadence, with the key property that no spell slot is consumed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can also cast the spell once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.
